name: Release Brief
description: Generate daily release brief with merged PRs and changes
instructions:
Generate a comprehensive release brief for the day:
1. List all merged PRs since last brief
2. Categorize changes (features, bug fixes, improvements, breaking changes)
3. Extract key changes from PR descriptions
4. Identify breaking changes
5. List contributors
6. Generate changelog entries
7. Suggest version bump (major, minor, patch)
8. Highlight security fixes

Provide a release brief with:
- Summary of changes
- Detailed changelog
- Breaking changes (if any)
- Contributors
- Recommended version
- Release notes draft
